2608.23429.title: ChebBooster: A Training-Free Approach for Efficient Diffusion Transformer Inference via Chebyshev-Inspired Extrapolation
2608.23429.paper_summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have shown strong performance in high-fidelity image generation, but their sampling process remains computationally intensive due to full model execution at every timestep. While cache-based acceleration has been explored to mitigate inference cost, naive reuse schemes suffer from low accuracy over long intervals, and Taylor-series-based extrapolation methods often face instability caused by Runge oscillations. In this paper, we propose ChebBooster, a training-free extrapolation framework based on Chebyshev polynomial theory that achieves stable and efficient acceleration for DiTs. Specifically, we adopt the Barycentric formulation to evaluate Chebyshev approximants with high numerical stability and minimal overhead, and further decouple the extrapolation into an offline weight precomputation phase and a lightweight online application stage. Extensive experiments across three representative DiT-based models, including DiT-XL/2, PixArt-$Σ$, and FLUX.1-dev, demonstrate that ChebBooster achieves consistent improvements in visual quality and inference efficiency, reaching up to $3.68\times$ latency speedup and $5.12\times$ FLOPs reduction, outperforming existing training-free baselines under diverse generation tasks and resolutions.
2608.23429.paper_summary_zh: 擴散Transformer（DiTs）在高保真圖像生成方面表現出色，但其取樣過程仍然因為每個時間步驟都需完整模型執行而計算密集。雖然已探索基於快取的加速方法以減輕推理成本，但天真的重用方案在長時間間隔內準確性較低，而基於泰勒級數的外推方法則常常面臨由於朗日振盪引起的不穩定性。在本文中，我們提出了ChebBooster，一種基於切比雪夫多項式理論的無需訓練的外推框架，實現了對DiTs的穩定和高效加速。具體而言，我們採用重心形式來評估具有高數值穩定性和最小開銷的切比雪夫近似，並進一步將外推解耦為離線權重預計算階段和輕量級在線應用階段。在三個具有代表性的基於DiT的模型（包括DiT-XL/2、PixArt-$Σ$和FLUX.1-dev）中進行的廣泛實驗表明，ChebBooster在視覺質量和推理效率上實現了一致的改進，達到高達$3.68\times$的延遲加速和$5.12\times$的FLOPs減少，超越了在多樣生成任務和解析度下現有的無訓練基準。
